optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Customer Operations Manager, Subscription Billing Platform

professionalSummary.text: Saw the subscription billing platform's monthly run through to completion in production for thirty-one runs in a row, holding the pager for the run and the finance escalation route from the first run of 2023.
professionalSummary.witness: Saw the subscription billing platform's monthly run through to completion in production for thirty-one runs in a row, holding the pager for the run and the finance escalation route from the first run of 2023.

experienceHighlights.text: Resolved the production incidents that delayed invoices or collections during those runs; the provider settlement outage of spring 2025 was the largest, and its record sits in the operations incident tracker under my name.
experienceHighlights.witness: Resolved the production incidents that delayed invoices or collections during those runs; the provider settlement outage of spring 2025 was the largest, and its record sits in the operations incident tracker under my name.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with the monthly billing run, incident resolution, change management, reporting to finance, and post-run documentation.
